name.ja: 30MM ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON RaD CC-3000 WRECKER ミルクトゥース
name.en: 30MM ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON RaD CC-3000 WRECKER Milktooth

description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、オーネスト・ブルートゥが操る「ミルクトゥース」が登場。
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," " Milktooth", operated by Honest Bluetooth, is now available.

description.ja: • 頭部、コア、腕部、脚部それぞれにシリーズ共通構造を採用し、ゲーム内同様に「アセンブル」をプラモデルで楽しめる。
description.en: • The head, core, arms, and legs each use the same structure as the series, allowing you to enjoy "assembling" the plastic model just like in the game.

description.ja: • 両肩武器と一部左手武器の取り付けには3mmジョイントを採用し様々なアセンブルに対応可能。
description.en: • 3mm joints are used to attach both shoulder weapons and some left-handed weapons, allowing for a variety of assemblies.

description.ja: • 武器は「WB-0000 BAD COOK」「WB-0010 DOUBLE TROUBLE」「BML-G2/P19SPL-12」「SB-033M MORLEY」が付属。
description.en: • Weapons include "WB-0000 BAD COOK ", " WB-0010 DOUBLE TROUBLE ", " BML-G2/P19SPL-12 ", and " SB-033M MORLEY".

description.ja: • 「WB-0010 DOUBLE TROUBLE」のチェーンソーは格納状態と展開状態の2種類が付属。
description.en: • "WB-0010 DOUBLE TROUBLE" chainsaw comes in two types: retracted state and expanded state.
